title: Edit Customer accepts a Min without a percentage on a flagged customer
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, flagged as an Internal customer with no shop supplies percentage and no Min.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, not flagged, with no shop supplies percentage, so the two windows can be compared.
custom_steps:
1. Open customer A's page.
  2. Click Edit Customer.
  3. Enter $15.00 in the Min shop supplies charge.
  4. Click Save.
  5. Open customer B's page.
  6. Click Edit Customer.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Customer A's page opens.

Step 2:

  • The Min field is enabled although no percentage is entered.

Step 3:

  • $15.00 shows.

Step 4:

  • The customer is saved with Min $15.00.

Step 5:

  • Customer B's page opens.

Step 6:

  • Customer B's Min field is disabled because no percentage is entered.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11767 (Story 10, Shop supplies on internal and no-charge work orders)

  • S10-R1: “An internal or no-charge work order carries one field "Shop supplies" (a dollar amount) in the block where a billable work order shows its totals. It is set when the work order becomes internal or no charge: the customer's Min shop supplies charge from the customer profile, or $0.00 when none is set. The percentage rule and the location percentage do not apply. On a flagged customer, Edit Customer accepts the Min without a shop supplies percentage (today Min is disabled until a percentage is entered); a percentage, if set, never applies to internal or no-charge work orders.”
